scope: Windows x86_64 desktop execution smoke on a generated one-second 55 Hz sine; no corpus-quality, silence, ARMv7, norns, or latency acceptance claim
findings: The concrete UMXHQ magnitude-mask and mixture-phase inverse-STFT loader executes and feeds the pinned Basic Pitch ONNX graph.
The Basic Pitch MIDI offset regression maps its 88 columns from MIDI 21 and limits BASS to MIDI 28..60.
A separate executable regression makes digital silence return no BASS candidates before model execution; this sine smoke is intentionally not a musical-onset quality oracle.
The three candidates on a sustained sine show that development-selected threshold/refractory settings still require the frozen active-lane corpus gate.
